static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and family, but has not yet discussed cooking-related distress with them; due to her negative attitude toward cooking, relationships with family becoming tense.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not received psychological counseling before/treatment; no similar problems with cooking before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, able to self-Reflect; emotionally frustrated but highly cooperative; able to identify and discuss negative Automatic thoughts, Positive attitude, willing to try changing.

basic_info.main_problem: I feel today's cooking accident will make me give up cooking, although I love it very much. This has led to feelings of failure and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because these feelings of failure and Self-doubt are affecting my passion for cooking and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: In the past, cooked successfully many times and received praise from friends, thereby forming a love of and devotion to cooking.

Recently failing when making a 'special meal' for herself alone at home, the dish being inedible; the event triggering intense feelings of failure, embarrassment and Self-doubt, becoming the starting point of the current problem.

special_situations.event: A serious mistake occurring when preparing a 'special meal' for herself alone at home, the dish being inedible
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail at something I love, it means I am not suited to continue doing it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding cooking, trying to comfort oneself through rationalization or seeking generalized encouragement from friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time was a disaster, I should just give up cooking

special_situations.event: Every time entering the kitchen or facing a new cooking challenge
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Either do it perfectly or it is a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking or only chooses the simplest dishes to lower the chance of mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot do it perfectly, then I should not do it

special_situations.event: When recalling past successes and being praised by friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Past successes do not represent current ability, one failure can negate everything before
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive evidence, only repeatedly replaying the failure scenes

special_situations.event: When recalling that failure, even without anyone watching feeling ashamed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I feel embarrassed, which shows I am really terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-criticizes and avoids trying again to avoid shame again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Too embarrassing, I should not try again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized in beloved cooking and prove they are good enough, maintaining competence and self-esteem
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, worrying one failure defines self-worth and brings shame
defense_goal: Avoids failure and shame by pursuing perfection
Avoiding cooking to lower Anxiety in the short term
Keeping distance from emotions through Intellectualization to maintain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, oneself who fails easily and deserves to be negated
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges / perfect standards (internalized high-demand others)
family members who do not understand and are dissatisfied with her negative attitude toward cooking

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on 'what failure means' or encourages him to face emotional experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences emotional exploration as a risk of losing control and being set back again, needing logical analysis to maintain safety and control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an objective, analytical tone, listing facts and reasoning, reducing emotion words and feeling descriptions, turning the topic to technical details or evidence.

manifestations: One cooking failure shook the identity of love, feeling past successes 'all do not count'
Enjoyment of and engagement in cooking have dropped markedly, eating habits affected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently using self-critical statements such as 'I am not good enough'
Self-demands with perfection as the standard ('must do it perfectly')
Negating overall ability after making mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Having a support system but not yet telling others about the cooking distress, choosing to bear it alone
Turning dissatisfaction with failure into self-blame and avoiding cooking

positive_force: Has a strong love for cooking and many successful experiences
Has received friends' positive feedback and praise
Positive attitude, willing to practice self-compassion and small-step attempts
Able to identify cognitive distortions and willing to conduct reality testing
Work performance not yet affected, life structure relatively stable
negative_force: Catastrophizing, negating the positive, black-and-white thinking and other cognitive distortions
Avoids cooking to lower Anxiety in the short term
Work pressure and personal expectations overlap, raising tension and sensitivity to failure
Not yet expressing distress to the support system, leading to bearing it alone and Increased sense of isolation

antecedent: Associating with memories of the last cooking failure
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionist rules and catastrophic beliefs are activated ('if I fail again I should give up')
target_behavior.function: avoiding possible failure and shame, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Declining passion for cooking, eating habits affected, Strained relationships with family members

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and Self-denial Automatic thoughts appearing when cooking
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I am not good enough' and mental filtering activated, only focusing on negative details
target_behavior.function: Seeks a sense of control and drives improvement through self-criticism (but actually adds pressure)
target_behavior.consequence: Increased tension and pain, decreased cooking efficiency and enjoyment, further Reinforcing avoidance patterns
